evidence_items.explanation: DeepSeek documents engineering that overlaps communication and computation to reduce bandwidth dependence. This establishes a successful adaptation, but does not identify what the team would have developed without restrictions.

The authors connect H800 limitations to regulatory compliance and describe model and parallelism choices addressing those limitations. This supports the proposed mechanism, but does not establish additional or accelerated innovation relative to unrestricted hardware.

evidence_items.explanation: The founder describes chip restrictions as a binding obstacle. That supports the existence of pressure to adapt, while cautioning against equating adaptation with an overall benefit from the restrictions.

unresolved_gaps: No retrieved development history establishes how much earlier or more extensively the innovations occurred because of export controls.
The evidence does not separate restriction-induced innovation from ordinary incentives to reduce training and inference costs.
The retrieved record does not establish the unintended nature of the specific innovation effect.
